messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT P1 - 5xx spike on /v1/generate (prod). Metric: 5m error rate 6.4% (baseline 0.2%). Suspected smart-routing fallback loop and KV-prefix cache mismatch. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1769004321
sre-oncall: Paging oncall. this is automated from incident-bot. tagging everyone in #incidents.
jamie: I'm oncall, grabbing it. setting priority P1. what's the customer impact right now?
cs-tilly: two enterprise customers (Acme, Atlas) reporting garbled outputs and intermittent 500s since ~18:00 UTC. approx 5-7% of requests affected according to logs. no data exfil reports so far.
maria-lopes: Logs show repeated fallbacks: requests originating us-west2 -> fallback eu-west1 -> fallback us-west2, causing rapid retry churn. Errors: \"KV_PREFIX_HIT model_mismatch\" present a lot.
eng-runtime: Confirmed. Root cause hypothesis: smart-routing fallback policy started routing to a model variant (gptx-2-8k-quant) that is incompatible with the existing KV prefix cache keys created by primary variant (gptx-2-16k). Cache keys were missing model_variant tag after recent routing change -> KV entries reused across variants leading to corrupted KV cache hits and bad responses.
levi_k: That matches what I see. Also noticed cache is keyed by prefix_hash + region only (no model_id). recent rollout removed model_id from cache key for perf reasons -> this created cross-variant reuse when fallback routes to different variant.
jamie: Ok. mitigation options?
eng-runtime: Short-term: disable smart-routing fallback policy for prod (force route to stable model), and purge KV prefix caches in hot regions. Longer term: re-add model variant to cache key and add guard to fallbacks.
jamie: Can someone post the exact commands to disable policy + purge cache? I'll run.
eng-runtime: Commands (prod, us-west2 & eu-west1):
```
# disable smart routing
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/v1/policies/smart-routing/actions" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INCIDENT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{\"action\":\"deactivate\",\"reason\":\"kv-prefix cross-variant reuse causing bad responses\"}'

# purge KV prefix cache (redis clusters)
for region in us-west2 eu-west1; do
  REDIS_HOST=redis-$region.kv.internal
  redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST -p 6379 --scan --pattern \"kvprefix:*\" | xargs -r -n 100 redis-cli -h $REDIS_HOST -p 6379 del
done
```
eng-runtime: Note: run one region at a time to avoid mass cache stampede.
jamie: Running disable now.
jamie: (18:07:12 UTC) ran policy deactivate command. response: {\"status\":\"ok\",\"policy\":\"smart-routing\",\"state\":\"deactivated\"}
jamie: Starting purge in us-west2 now. Will monitor errors.
eng-runtime: I recommend keeping a conservative TTL rewarm after purge. Also set rollout throttle to 0 while we validate.
jamie: Purge complete for us-west2 (18:12:03 UTC). Error rate fell from 6.4% -> 1.1% within 2 minutes.
jamie: Purge eu-west1 started (18:15:40 UTC).
alex-nguyen: I'm coming onto the incident to help with monitoring, taking over once you're ready to hand off @jamie. I'll watch the dashboards and customer comms.
jamie: Good handover. eu-west1 purge finished (18:20:10 UTC). Error rate now 0.3%. Looks stable.
product-ops: What's the customer impact window we should communicate? can we estimate affected requests and time range?
cs-tilly: Affected window: ~18:00-18:20 UTC. Estimated impacted requests 12k total across two customers (about 0.4% of their traffic). Recommend a brief outage/incident email acknowledging degraded outputs and remediation completed - offer to re-run impacted jobs.
maria-lopes: Added a temporary regression alert to block re-enabling smart-routing until cache-key fix is deployed.
levi_k: For follow-up: 1) reintroduce model_id into KV cache key; 2) add unit/integration test for fallback variant mixing; 3) add canary that validates tokenization/kv compatibility before routing. I'll file the tickets.
jamie: Handover to @alex-nguyen at 18:30 UTC. summary: smart-routing disabled, KV prefixes purged in us-west2/eu-west1, error rate back to normal, customer ops notified to prepare comms. next steps: patch cache key + add pre-route compatibility check. logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/queries/incident/1769004321
alex-nguyen: Taking over. I'll keep incident open for postmortem and coordinate with eng-runtime + levi for fixes. @product-ops and @cs-tilly please prepare a short blameless customer note. I'll update status page.
jamie: I'm offcall at 19:00 UTC — handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
product-ops: Drafted email and status page update, will send after review. tagging legal for wording: @legal (FYI).
eng-runtime: Filed follow-up issue: RDW-4567 \"KV cache key must include model_variant and region\". Prioritizing in next cycle. Also adding runtime guard to avoid routing to incompatible variants.
cs-tilly: Customers notified, they'd like a short postmortem. I'll coordinate with you all on follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved -> mitigated state. Duration: ~30m. Please attach timeline and notes to the incident ticket 1769004321.
alex-nguyen: Closing thread here, will post postmortem draft in 24h. Thanks everyone for quick response. :tada:
